title: Tasks
notes: Table view rebuilt on ListPage (PageHeader/FilterBar/DataTable/hover actions/infinite scroll/bulk select+delete+complete/CSV export of full filtered set/EmptyState) with row click -> detail page instead of a drawer; a Kanban toggle view is kept alongside as a bespoke board (KanbanBoard domain component) since the manifest's showcase script calls out drag-to-Done. Detail page rebuilt on DetailPage archetype (Overview/Activity/Related tabs, ActivityTimeline from comments+lifecycle events, Comments CRUD moved into Related tab so it is no longer orphaned). Assignee and linked lead are now RelationCombobox everywhere (create dialog, edit dialog) instead of raw IDs (#33 fixed). Create/edit forms now include assignedTo, category, leadId (#54 fixed). sendMessageDialog not wired -- no direct messaging surface exists for tasks in the current design (assignee has no messaging affordance in scope); phoneInput/addressAutocomplete/currencyInput not applicable to this entity. Status enum mismatch (#56) not touched -- normalizeTask still maps legacy pending/completed/cancelled values from the API, which is an API-shape issue outside the fileAllowlist (tasks.ts request/response shapes are frozen per slice rules).
showcaseScript: Create a task assigned to a teammate and linked to a lead
Add a subtask and a comment
Drag the task to Done and show the dashboard count update
